## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`...)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] `docs/SPEC.md` / README updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Small enough to review in one sitting (otherwise split it)
- [ ] A human has read and understood any AI-generated code in this PR
